items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: And also the -- who booked me into the Howard? Mr. Mann, the man who owned the Howard.

ctx.x: I tell you, sometimes -- now, there was a fellow in Washington, I think I have his picture and his name. He was the one that booked me into the Bali in Washington. And then, as I say, Johnny Kerry booked me into Gibson's in Philadelphia. And also the -- who booked me into the Howard? Mr.

Mann, the man who owned the Howard. And the -- what was that man's name? The man that owned the place would talk to me, he'd talk to me about the contracts. Uh-huh. Very seldom through a booking agent. Uh-huh. Only Mr. GlaSer. Things I got through Mr. GlaSer were the big things, like, you know. Not the little houses in Philadelphia, and all.
Would white people come to Gibson's Standard Theater?
